history.outcomeText: Gained 20 science. Habitability increased by 25 points.

history.outcomeText: Recovered Last Light of Haven, a frigate.

history.outcomeText: Paid 20 credits. Added 1 population at Solace.

factions.name: The Concord
factions.description: A federation of survivors, united by a fragile promise. Receives one additional order each turn.

factions.name: Veyr Consortium
factions.description: Trade leagues that turn the frontier into opportunity. Earns 25% more credits.

factions.name: Khar Dominion
factions.description: A martial society forged on hostile worlds. Warships deal 15% more damage.

factions.name: The Luminous Choir
factions.description: A communion seeking the intelligence behind the ancient gates. Produces 25% more science.

log.text: Solace completed Colony Ark.
Survey complete at Iona: Volcanic world, 22% habitability.
Survey complete at Morrow: Terran world, 86% habitability.
Research complete: Adaptive Biospheres. Colonize harsh worlds with 30% habitability. Unlocks Habitation Domes.
Survey complete at Cinder: Ocean world, 74% habitability.
Survey complete at Aldebaran: Arid world, 63% habitability.
Antares completed Exchange Port.
Survey complete at Peregrine: Arid world, 58% habitability.
Survey complete at Thalassa: Terran world, 87% habitability.
First contact: Khar Dominion. A diplomatic channel is open.
Survey complete at Lumen: Terran world, 90% habitability.
Trade established between The Concord and The Luminous Choir. Borders are open; existing grievances remain.
Survey complete at Sable: Glacial world, 37% habitability.
Survey complete at Asterion: Ocean world, 72% habitability.
Solace completed Research Enclave.
A Banner in the Dark: Claim the lost treasury. Gained 90 credits.
Survey complete at Elysian: Ocean world, 76% habitability.
Elysian: A Banner in the Dark detected. An expedition can investigate.
The Hollow Sun: Redirect the foundries. Gained 85 minerals.
Survey complete at Stillwater: Terran world, 83% habitability.
Stillwater: The Hollow Sun detected. An expedition can investigate.
Survey complete at Orison: Glacial world, 36% habitability.
Research complete: Deep-space Logistics. +1 order each turn. Enables dormant starlane restoration and opens automated industry and larger hulls.
First contact: The Luminous Choir. A diplomatic channel is open.
Survey complete at Seraph: Barren world, 17% habitability.
Echo of the First Gate: Map the resonance. Gained 75 science.
Research complete: Resonance Theory. +2 science per colony. The first step toward understanding the gates.
Survey complete at Zenith: Volcanic world, 22% habitability.
Zenith: Echo of the First Gate detected. An expedition can investigate.
The Hollow Sun: Finish the ancient escort. Recovered Last Light of Haven, a frigate.
Survey complete at Haven: Terran world, 88% habitability.
Haven: The Hollow Sun detected. An expedition can investigate.
A Thousand Sleeping Voices: Bring them home. Paid 20 credits. Added 1 population at Solace.
Dormant starlane detected between Iona and Halcyon. Colonize either endpoint and research Deep-space Logistics to restore it.
Survey complete at Halcyon: Glacial world, 45% habitability.
Halcyon: A Thousand Sleeping Voices detected. An expedition can investigate.
The Last Observatory: Take the timing core. Gained 65 minerals and 20 science.
Velorum: The Last Observatory detected. An expedition can investigate.
A new beginning: Antares joins Concord.
First mandate: compare your two surveyed prospects, choose a first colony, and send your Pathfinder beyond the familiar stars.
The gates have been silent for centuries. Today, the Concord returns to the stars.

dispatches.text: Uncontacted civilization and The Luminous Choir announced a trade agreement. Their borders are open to each other.
